normalization: Fixed native physical ranges; equal time-averaged position/velocity/standing blocks; SO3 native-reference and perturbation rotations split total orientation weight.
primary_lifecycle: Regular native autoreset, including one compute on reset frame
initial_reset_sensitivity: One-control-step offset; explicit initial reset raw standing velocity lasts one step, regular autoreset applies zero mask before first action.
excluded: raw standing uniforms beyond their boolean marker
raw velocity values when standing in regular episodes (initial-reset slot0 pulse is retained separately)
rotation_limitation: Reference SO3 target follows the exact native function at a fixed pre-policy reset state. Later state-dependent target rotations are not precomputed; perturbation SO3 descriptors retain their input dependence. No claim of full moving-state orientation equivalence.
